name: print-social-red-hiring-story-with-megaphone-on-red-chair
title: Red 'We Are Hiring!' story with a megaphone resting on a red chair and a translucent role panel
whatItIs: A vertical red story with a white headline where 'WE ARE' and 'PROFESSIONAL' sit in white boxes, a black megaphone lying on a red modern chair, a translucent red panel of open positions, CV and WhatsApp details, and a white curved footer with perks and handle.
whatItMeans: Striking and witty; the megaphone on an empty chair says 'this seat is calling you'.
techniques: Combine two metaphors: chair and megaphone.
Reverse words out of white boxes in the headline.
Close with a curved white footer.

vocabulary.definition: Coloured text knocked out of a solid box.
A bottom area with a wavy edge.
